datasets.description: Clean, wideband, long utterances: the accuracy ceiling.
Additive white noise at 5 dB SNR.
8 kHz narrowband channel: loses F1 detail and all energy above F3.
Moderate reverberation (T60 = 0.4 s) at 10 dB SNR.
Short (1 s) enrollment, babble interference, mild reverb.
Hardest point: -3 dB babble through a narrowband channel.

systems.description: MFCC+CMVN -> global training mean -> cosine. Weak baseline, no LDA and no nuisance compensation.
Full front end + VTLN + LDA + GMM-UBM + MAP, scored by cosine on the MAP means.
Reference system: full front end, GMM-UBM + MAP, total variability + NBC + CMS, PLDA scoring.
Reference system with the pure-numpy DSP backend: quantifies the cost of having no librosa.
Reference system fused with the cosine backend; fusion weight fitted on the dev half only.

switch_documentation.hypothesis: A 64-component UBM under-resolves the acoustic space, so MAP adaptation cannot place a speaker precisely.
switch_documentation.remedy: Increase n_gauss, or lower the MAP relevance factor so adaptation relies less on component resolution.

switch_documentation.hypothesis: Cepstral mean subtraction on the supervector removes the session offset; without it the LLR sees a constant shift as speaker evidence.
switch_documentation.remedy: Restore CMS, or subtract a session-level supervector mean estimated on the training split.

switch_documentation.hypothesis: Cepstral mean/variance normalisation removes per-utterance channel gain; without it the global mean absorbs the recording level.
switch_documentation.remedy: Restore per-utterance CMVN, or add a session-level gain normalisation before the front end.

switch_documentation.hypothesis: LDA projects onto the between-speaker subspace; without it the GMM models nuisance directions as if they were speaker identity.
switch_documentation.remedy: Increase the LDA rank towards n_speakers-1, or add explicit nuisance projection (NBC).

switch_documentation.hypothesis: L2 length normalisation removes the correlation between i-vector norm and utterance duration; without it short enrollments score low for reasons unrelated to identity.
switch_documentation.remedy: Restore length normalisation, or apply SLV normalisation instead.

switch_documentation.hypothesis: Nuisance back-channel compensation removes the session directions; without it the i-vector absorbs channel and noise variation.
switch_documentation.remedy: Estimate more nuisance directions, or estimate them from a channel-varied training corpus.

switch_documentation.hypothesis: VTLN aligns the vocal tract length; without it speakers with long and short tracts are separated mainly by channel rather than identity.
switch_documentation.remedy: Widen the VTLN search range, or add a cepstral-mean-based tract-length normalisation.

switch_documentation.hypothesis: PLDA models the two-covariance structure explicitly; a plain cosine treats between- and within-speaker variability identically.
switch_documentation.remedy: Restore PLDA scoring, or whiten by Sigma_n before the cosine.
